lines.text: Many learners say: I want that you help me.
Better: I want you to help me.
You to! I want you to come.

data.wrong: I want that you help me.
data.right: I want you to help me.

native.tip: want 뒤에 that절 대신 “you to”! “I want you to help me”예요.
native.caption: “I want that you help me”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 want 뒤에는 that절이 아니라 ‘사람 + to 동사’를 써요. “I want you to help me”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “you to”. want you to로 말해요! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Do not use that after want. Say “I want you to help me”.
en.caption: Do you say “I want that you help me”? 😅 After want, use a person plus “to”, not a that clause. “I want you to help me” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
